'''Black Gabaki''' was a type of [[Mushroom/Legends|mushroom]] that grew on the north side of [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]]. It could be used to produced [[Neutron Pixie]], a type of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. Like [[Grey Gabaki]], Black Gabaki grew from the droppings of [[shaoryn]].<ref name="LoNH" />

The mushroom needed to be flash-frozen immediately after harvesting. If it was not, it would quickly turn stale and [[Color/Legends|gray]].<ref name="LoNH" />
